text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Dants-san. Thank you so much for the gift.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
A flower... an alstroemeria. A vibrant 
orange one.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. I'm so glad you like it~! Taking 
care of it all this time was totally worth 
it~

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
? Those flowers... Did you arrange them 
yourself, Dantsu-san?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. It's to celebrate Believe-chan, 
after all. I really wanted to grow them 
myself~!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"Even so... hehe. I got a little worried 
halfway through about whether it would 
bloom properly, though."

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Still! That's precisely when I decided to 
take it slow and steady, just like you 
usually do, Believe-chan! I nurtured it 
with lots and lots of patience~!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
The flowers you gave me... they should 
take about two weeks to reach full bloom, 
right?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Ah, um... yeah! They say the flowers 
are just about to open and be in full 
bloom!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
In that case, I shall fire a vase in the 
kiln while we wait.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
"I will create... a vase worthy of holding 
them. Just you watch."

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Wa... Waaah~! Thank you! Once it's 
finished, I'd love for you to show it to 
me too!
